Explore features Support

Requires macOS 14.0 or later

Edit, preview, and export

Edit .md files

Create or open a Markdown document and use syntax highlighting and line numbers to find headings, lists, and code blocks.

Preview as you write

Switch between Editor, Split, and Preview layouts to check tables, block quotes, and task lists.

Export to your Mac

Save an A4 or US Letter PDF to the location you choose, using the toolbar or the keyboard shortcut.

Give long documents clean page breaks

Pagination keeps headings with the content that follows and preserves tables and code blocks when they fit on a page. Text in the exported PDF stays selectable, copyable, and searchable.
